- Crafting table : 6 x [[gv:nugget_mox_fuel|Nugget of MOX Fuel]].
- Crafting table (x3) : 2 x [[gv:ingot_mox_fuel|Ingot of MOX Fuel]].
- Crafting table (x3) : 2 x [[gv:billet_uranium_fuel|Uranium Fuel Billet]], Plutonium-239 Billet.
(1 more recipes: see JEI.)

[[gv:ingot_mox_fuel|Ingot of MOX Fuel]], [[gv:nugget_mox_fuel|Nugget of MOX Fuel]], [[gv:pwr_fuel_mox|MOX PWR Fuel Rod]], [[gv:rbmk_fuel_mox|MOX RBMK Fuel Rod]].
